utterance: Tell me about a time you managed an upset patient or family member. What was the situation, and how was it resolved?

A patient's son was upset that visiting hours had been cut back, and he started raising his voice at the desk. I took him aside, explained why the policy changed, and offered to set up a video call with his mother that evening. Honestly, it never really got resolved: he still filed a complaint, and I never heard what came of it.
